Evan Lee: hey all, Evan here starting week 1. quick flow question: who owns the "who-to-ping" matrix for infra/Dedicated/Private? also if I get a permission denied pushing a model, what immediate steps?

Rina Sato: welcome Evan! :wave: For the matrix, we keep a living doc in the handbook (handbook/org-owners). But short answer: eng-platform = Dedicated + runtime; eng-infra owns networking and VPC for Private; security owns keys and compliance.

Max O'Neal: immediate steps for perms: 1) screenshot the error, 2) check youre in the right GitHub org/team, 3) open an access-request and DM an owner. If it's blocking a deploy, add "deploy-blocker" to the request and ping #eng-platform.

Priya Desai: adding: access-request link -> https://redwood.internal/access-request. Choose type "dedicated" or "private". Put exact error logs and the resource names. We try to handle urgent blockers within 2 hours during core hours.

Evan Lee: great, thanks. who specifically should I mention for Dedicated quota bumps?

Rina Sato: tag @max for initial triage; eng-platform will route to capacity for scheduling. For quota increases that affect billing/committed capacity, include product owner and cc @finance-ops.

Max O'Neal: FYI if it's just a temporary test bump we can often add a soft quota for a day. For production capacity changes we need the typical ticket fields: team, model, steady_qps, peak_qps, p99 target, retention. Example line: team=rdx-search, model=rdx-quant-3b, steady=8, peak=24, p99=120ms.

eng-oncall-bot: Current on-call: Priya Desai (week 1894990000). To escalate: post in #eng-oncall with the issue and use "!pager" to notify the on-call. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quick-escalation

Evan Lee: awesome, filing the form now. any other "first-week" things I should know about org ownership?

Rina Sato: maybe two pointers: 1) join #eng-platform and #eng-oncall read-only, 2) check the ownership matrix in the handbook and star the owners you might contact. Happy to walk through if you want a quick 15-min intro.

Evan Lee: would love that. thanks everyone :)
